## The file

The most useful bug report is **a file that misbehaves**. If you can attach the
`.dat` file, do. If you cannot — most measurement data cannot be shared — paste:

1. the header block (everything above `[Data]`), with the sample name and any
   comment fields removed;
2. the column-name line;
3. a handful of representative data rows.
